summary: Formal infinite Nat reverse-successor interpretation satisfies a local source in every finite nonempty induced subgraph and has no causal loops, but the full relation has no source at all. This is a verified mathematical counterexample to the local-finite-to-global quantifier shift, not a physical infinity or a metaphysical coherence certificate. See TruthCore.Causality.FiniteRestriction.finiteLocalSourcesAndNoGlobalSource and docs/causal-finite-branching-and-psr-syllogisms.md.
